title: Atlas node
description: An entity of the analysed target. Facts about it (name, type, summary) are hypotheses, not node fields.

id.description: Prefixed by kind: bin_, fn_, ty_, gl_, str_, sys_, fmt_, sh_, res_, unk_.

binary.description: The binary the node belongs to. Absent on a binary.

size.description: Size in bytes, when the node occupies memory.

thunk.description: On a function: a stub that only jumps elsewhere (an import's PLT entry, for example), not source code of its own. Absent means not known to be one.

label.description: Raw label from the tools (e.g. sub_401000), not a hypothesis. On a string node, the string's contents.
